notes: Taming animals by spending apples, fish and fantasy fruit, with a shop selling the feed and a tree that yields three fruits every two minutes, is a collection loop rather than roleplay — Simulation's shared persistent world with no personal plot, which is the Incremental Simulator bundle of a storefront hub and circulation out to where value is produced. The answer keeps the fantasy world as a zone inside the same map, so the five biomes (fantasy, jungle, garden, grassland, sea) are one contiguous surface and there is no P4. The animals and insects that populate each biome are the ambient population rather than hostile spawners, and the fantasy tree is the shared timed resource field the whole server draws from. Decided without a user: dropped the preset's gate-progression because nothing walls a zone off — the fruit and apple costs are the gate — treated the shop as an open-air stall in the hub so no interior is generated and the build stays P0, and read the sea as a flat swim envelope for feeding marine animals from the shallows, which raises no CHECK. Roleplay & Avatar Sim was considered for the pet keeping and left unnamed: there is no town, housing or avatar dress-up here. The prices and quantities (3 won per apple, 2 and 5 apples for insects, 15 fruits, 6 fish) are economy values the layout carries only as counts.
